name: av_unc_two_args_not_a_declaration
source:
{ UncertaintyOf with two arguments is not a declaration target. }
x = 3
UncertaintyOf(x, 1) = 0.1
y = x^2

error.message: There are 3 equations and 2 variables. The problem is overspecified and cannot be solved. Redundant relation (no free variable left to determine): UncertaintyOf(x,1)=0.1. A common cause: the same physics stated twice — a boundary pinning a quantity a component already defines (a re-equated mixer pressure, a T-pinned wall state), or two property calls restating one relation.
